data.one_liner: An unofficial Flutter client for the Strava V3 API with OAuth2 and repository-based endpoints.
data.what_it_does: Provides a client for the Strava V3 API, handling OAuth2 authentication with automatic token refresh, structured error handling, and typed request/response models for activities, athletes, segments, and more.
use_when: You need to integrate Strava data into your Flutter application.
You want built-in OAuth2 flow with automatic token refreshing and storage.
avoid_when: You are building a web application (web platform is not supported).
You only need generic HTTP networking without Strava-specific models.
strengths: Handles complex OAuth2 flows and automatic token refresh out of the box.
Provides repository-per-domain API structure covering athletes, activities, segments, etc.
Typed models generated with json_serializable and structured error handling via Fault.
weaknesses: It is an unofficial third-party API client.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding custom redirect URL scheme configuration in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist, and setting up an API client in Strava settings.
